about.heading: Building scalable infrastructure, automating delivery, and monitoring modern cloud environments.
about.description:
I’m Lasya Mandapati, a Computer Science & Engineering graduate and aspiring DevOps & Cloud Engineer with hands-on training in cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and monitoring.

I’ve worked with technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, and cloud security tools through practical learning and project implementations.

I’m looking to begin my career in a Cloud or DevOps role where I can apply my skills, solve real-world infrastructure challenges, and continue growing as an engineer.

projects.title: CI/CD Pipeline for E-commerce Application
projects.shortDescription: Designed and implemented an end-to-end CI/CD workflow for an e-commerce-style application using AWS infrastructure, Jenkins automation, Ansible deployment, code quality analysis, and monitoring.
projects.description: Designed and implemented an end-to-end CI/CD pipeline for an e-commerce-style application using AWS infrastructure, Jenkins automation, Ansible deployment, code quality analysis, and monitoring.
projects.overview: Built an end-to-end DevOps pipeline to automate infrastructure provisioning, application delivery, code quality checks, and observability for an e-commerce-style application using AWS and modern automation tools.
keyImplementations: Infrastructure as Code: Terraform provisions AWS infrastructure including VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, and IAM.
Automated CI/CD: Jenkins automates build, testing, and deployment across the application lifecycle.
Automated Configuration & Deployment: Ansible automates deployment to Apache Tomcat.
Code Quality & Security: SonarQube and Ansible Vault improve code quality and secret protection.
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus and Grafana provide metrics, visualization, and alerting.
Storage & Reliability: S3 versioning, cross-region replication, and AWS scaling/optimization concepts support resilient operations.

detailSections.title: Project Overview
detailSections.text: Designed and implemented an end-to-end CI/CD pipeline for an e-commerce-style application using AWS infrastructure, Jenkins automation, Ansible deployment, code quality analysis, and monitoring.

detailSections.title: Architecture / Workflow
detailSections.text: Developer → Git → Jenkins → SonarQube → Terraform/AWS infrastructure → Ansible → Tomcat → Prometheus → Grafana

detailSections.title: Infrastructure
detailSections.text: Terraform was used to provision AWS resources including VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, and IAM, enabling repeatable cloud infrastructure management.

detailSections.title: CI/CD Implementation
detailSections.text: Jenkins orchestrated the application build, testing, and deployment pipeline, ensuring automated delivery from code to runtime.

detailSections.title: Security
detailSections.text: Sensitive configuration values were protected using Ansible Vault, while SonarQube improved code quality and secure delivery practices.

detailSections.title: Monitoring
detailSections.text: Prometheus and Grafana were configured to collect metrics, visualize infrastructure and application health, and support alerting.

detailSections.title: Scaling / Reliability
detailSections.text: AWS optimization concepts included right-sizing and Auto Scaling to improve infrastructure efficiency and resilience.

detailSections.title: Technologies Used
detailSections.text: AWS, Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Prometheus, Grafana, Git, SonarQube, Apache Tomcat.

keyImplementations: Infrastructure Automation: Terraform provisions the Amazon EKS environment.
Containerization: Docker images are built and managed for microservices.
Kubernetes Deployment: Applications are deployed and managed using Kubernetes/EKS.
Helm Packaging: Helm charts package and manage Kubernetes applications.
GitOps Delivery: Argo CD provides automated GitOps-based application delivery.
Auto Scaling: HPA automatically scales workloads according to resource utilization.
Security & Resource Management: RBAC, namespaces, and resource quotas manage access and resources.
Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus and Grafana provide monitoring, visualization, and alerting.

detailSections.title: Project Overview
detailSections.text: Implemented a containerized microservices deployment workflow using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, and observability tools.

detailSections.title: Architecture / Workflow
detailSections.text: Source Code → Docker Image → Container Registry → Amazon EKS → Kubernetes → Helm → Argo CD → HPA → Prometheus → Grafana

detailSections.title: Infrastructure
detailSections.text: Terraform automated the provisioning of the Amazon EKS environment and supporting cloud resources for the cluster and workloads.

detailSections.title: Deployment Process
detailSections.text: Docker images were built and pushed to a private registry, then deployed to Kubernetes with Helm-managed configuration and Argo CD-driven delivery.

detailSections.title: Security
detailSections.text: RBAC, namespaces, and resource quotas were implemented to manage access, isolation, and resource allocation across workloads.

detailSections.title: Monitoring
detailSections.text: Prometheus and Grafana were configured to monitor Kubernetes cluster health, workload metrics, and application performance.

detailSections.title: Scaling / Reliability
detailSections.text: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler and proactive monitoring practices helped improve workload scaling, availability, and operational resilience.

detailSections.title: Technologies Used
detailSections.text: Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, AWS.
